bibliographic-data.invention-title: GRAPHEN UND DIE HERSTELLUNG VON GRAPHEN
GRAPHENE AND THE PRODUCTION OF GRAPHENE

nplcit.text: - Phys. Chem. Chem. Phys., (20070000), vol. 9, pages 1276 - 1290
- Angew. Chem. Int. Ed., (20130000), vol. 52, pages 754 - 757

abstract.p: Compositions comprising hydrogenated and dehydrogenated graphite comprising a plurality of flakes. At least one flake in ten has a size in excess of ten square micrometers. For example, the flakes can have an average thickness of 10 atomic layers or less.
